item.title: Wastewater could be pumped into ocean to stop stench
item.description: The wastewater treatment plant. Photo: CCC Christchurch City Council is investigating pumping partially treated wastewater straight into the ocean via an outfall pipe to reduce the stench coming from its treatment plant.

item.title: Rare cancer claims life of young detective
item.description: Sophie Moore underwent extensive treatment for a rare and aggressive form of blood cancer. Photo: Givealittle A Christchurch detective, who was raised in Gore, has died from a rare form of blood cancer, just days after marrying her "soulmate".

item.title: Charges laid over sinking of HMNZS Manawanui
item.description: The Manawanui ran aground in Samoa in October 2024. Photo: Profile Boats / supplied Charges have been laid in relation to the loss of Royal New Zealand Navy vessel HMNZS Manawanui, off the coast of Samoa in October 2024.

item.title: At least 31 killed in Israeli strikes as conflict spreads to Lebanon
item.description: A destroyed car stands amid debris from a damaged residential building in Beirut, Lebanon as Israel announced the launch of strikes on the nation. Photo: Social media via Reuters Hezbollah has attacked Israel to avenge the killing of Iran's Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, prompting Israeli strikes on Beirut and setting the group at odds with Lebanese leaders who want the country kept out of a regional war.
